task.title: Trace a setting source
task.shortdesc: Trace a configured setting to baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw source attribution.

prereq.p: Open a configured setting in All settings.

context.p: Source attribution helps explain why a value exists and whether changing it would override a baseline, CIS layer, manual edit, import, or raw fallback.

step.cmd: Open the setting detail or configured summary that shows source badges.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Identify whether the value comes from baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw source.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Follow related CIS or profile context links when a generated layer contributed the value.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Record the source before editing, removing, or resetting the setting.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: You know where the configured value came from and can explain the impact of changing it.

postreq.p: Recovery: if source attribution is ambiguous, compare the profile with a clean baseline or inspect the imported source document.
